diffs.diff: thermocouple temperature (degC): datasheet reading gives 0.25 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: MAX31855 datasheet Table 2 (Memory Map - Bit Weights and Functions): '14-BIT THERMOCOUPLE TEMPERATURE DATA' D31..D18, 'MSB 2^10 (1024 degC) ... LSB 2^-2 (0.25 degC)'; Thermal Characteristics: 'Thermocouple Temperature Data Resolution 0.25 degC'. The model already uses this: part.json sim.spiReplies[0].bytes[0] = {control:'value', bits:14, scale:0.25, signed:true}, and the driver returns tc * 0.25 from the signed 14-bit field (v >> 18) & 0x3FFF. The gate reported 'none' only because it reads sim.responses/measure, while spi-device models keep their constants in sim.spiReplies (required by src/core/customParts.ts).

diffs.diff: internal reference junction temperature (degC): datasheet reading gives 0.0625 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: MAX31855 datasheet Table 2: '12-BIT INTERNAL TEMPERATURE DATA' D15..D4, 'MSB 2^6 (64 degC) ... LSB 2^-4 (0.0625 degC)'; Thermal Characteristics: 'Cold-Junction Temperature Data Resolution 0.0625 degC'. The model already uses this: part.json sim.spiReplies[0].bytes[3] = {control:'internal', bits:12, scale:0.0625, signed:true}, and the driver returns cj * 0.0625 from the signed 12-bit field (v >> 4) & 0xFFF. The gate's 'none' comes from it not reading sim.spiReplies.
